source.summary: Chrome freeform profile for Google search and general browser app-control learning.

windowing.fallback: Use foreground only inside the frame lane; stop if Chrome cannot be kept in freeform or a similarly bounded surface.

searchBox.note: Observed Google search input field inside Chrome freeform frame.

clearButton.note: Observed clear affordance for stale query.

searchButton.note: Observed submit affordance after entering query.

googleSearch.intent: Run a Google search in Chrome while minimizing whole-phone takeover.
preferredPath: Try deep link / intent URL first.
Keep Chrome in freeform bounds before any UI action.
Verify query/result text from uiautomator XML.
Record elapsed time and frame-lane status into appControlRuns.
frameFallback: Use searchBox bounds, clear stale text if needed, type query, tap searchButton.
Stop rather than taking over whole screen if the frame is lost.
successSignals: visible query contains requested search text

authorizedForegroundWebBurst.intent: Rapidly operate a human-foregrounded, human-authorized web page in Chrome without requiring a frame-in-frame.
scopeLimits: Only the current foreground page and the named task are authorized.
Do not launch unrelated apps or switch accounts.
Do not store secrets, cookies, authorization headers, payment details, or raw sensitive form values.
Return control at completion, page mismatch, focus loss, or any sensitive gate.
preferredPath: Human opens or foregrounds the exact page and grants a short takeover window.
Probe current Chrome focus, screenshot, XML, URL/title/page signature, and useful semantic nodes in one batch.
Plan the next actions from semantic XML/DOM selectors first; use coordinates only as last-resort action points with fresh evidence.
Execute a bounded burst of actions in one Shizuku loop instead of one terminal command per tap.
Capture final screenshot/XML/focus and submit app_control.record_run plus browser_sessions.record_episode.
stopSignals: Foreground package is no longer com.android.chrome.
URL/title/page signature no longer matches the authorized page.
CAPTCHA, login verification, payment, purchase, account-security, destructive action, or unapproved consent appears.
The target selector is missing or stale after a layout-changing action.
The burst exceeds maxBurstMs or maxUiActions.
humanActions: Click CAPTCHA/login/payment/destructive/sensitive gates when they are required.
Re-authorize if the page changes scope.
agentActions: Navigate within the authorized page flow.
authorizedForegroundWebBurst.promotionRule: May create candidate browser discoveries immediately; trusted household replay requires Playwright DOM/accessibility selector ladders, not coordinates alone.

failureFixes.symptom: Intent URL opens but results remain stale
failureFixes.fix: Focus search input, clear stale query, enter requested query, submit inside frame.
Use existing freeform window bounds instead of forcing a new mode mid-run.
Promote this profile to Home Center cloud and execute from app-specific config instead of terminal click scripts.
